item.title: Taking on Trump: Canada and EU forge closer ties – The Latest
item.description: Canadian prime minister, Mark Carney, has welcomed the EU’s proposal for Canada to become the bloc’s first ‘associate member’, despite threats from Donald Trump over the plan. The US president said Washington could impose ‘very serious tariffs’ or halt trade if the EU went ahead with the plan. But in a defiant speech to the European parliament, Carney called for ‘deep cooperation’ and said polling showed the overwhelming majority of Canadians supported closer ties with Europe. Lucy Hough speaks to Europe correspondent Jon Henley – watch on YouTube Continue reading... Fuente: The Guardian - World.

item.description: In this edition of Perspective, the acting Prosecutor of the International Criminal Court tells FRANCE 24 that the court is needed now more than ever to ensure there is no gap for impunity. Mame Mandiaye Niang says the court’s job is to step in if domestic justice systems fail. The Senegalese judge is at the centre of a storm amid sanctions put on the court by the US after its issuing of arrest warrants for Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu and former Defence Minister Yoav Gallant over Israel’s actions in Gaza. item.title: Carney pushes Canada-EU ties beyond trade
item.description: Canadian Prime Minister Mark Carney used his address to the European Parliament to signal that Ottawa wants to deepen its partnership with the EU beyond trade, expanding cooperation on energy, AI, space and payment sovereignty, while also seeking to join the Erasmus programme. FRANCE 24's Dave Keating explains how the push reflects Canada's broader strategy to build stronger alliances beyond the United States without seeking to join the EU's single market, even as questions remain over how those ambitions can be turned into concrete action. Fuente: France 24 - English.

item.title: Erdogan to sidestep Turkey’s constitutional term limits in early 2028 vote, adviser says
item.description: Turkish President Recep Tayyip Erdogan intends to run in an early election in 2028 in order to circumvent the constitutional term limits he would face if he serves out his full current term, a top adviser said Thursday. Under Turkey's constitution, parliament can trigger early elections given the support of 360 lawmakers, meaning the ruling AKP and its nationalist ally MHP will need support of at least 34 more lawmakers. item.title: Argentina intensifica su ofensiva legal contra empresas vinculadas al proyecto Sea Lion en Malvinas
item.description: El proyecto Sea Lion está en el centro de la conversación argentina contra empresas que operan en la zona de las islas Malvinas. Hace casi dos semanas, el presidente Javier Milei anunció medidas legales para intentar ejercer más presión sobre empresas con proyectos de hidrocarburos en la plataforma continental argentina, sobre la que se encuentran las islas; y hace una semana, el Gobierno anunció la presentación de una denuncia penal contra cinco empresas en particular. Informe de nuestro corresponsal Natalio Cosoy. Fuente: France 24 - Español.
item.dc:creator: FRANCE24

item.title: "Un acto hostil": la dura amenaza de Donald Trump contra la Unión Europea por su posible alianza con Canadá
item.description: El presidente estadounidense advirtió que responderá con "aranceles muy fuertes" si el bloque avanza con la medida. También fulminó a su vecino, al que describió como un "socio comercial terrible". Fuente: Clarín - Mundo.
